SEO AUDIT

Davis Dental — SEO audit

Clear issues, real evidence and focused fixes.

66 sitemap URLs · 67 distinct HTML pages · read-only · October 7

Business and article schema IDs overlapThe mobile hero image is discovered lateNews cards select overly large thumbnailsFix order
01

Business and article schema IDs overlap

On 19 article pages, Dentist and WebPage share an ID, and the brand Davis Dental is declared as a Person author.

  • Give the practice a stable #dentist ID, each page a separate #webpage ID, and the brand author/publisher an Organization ID; keep accurate business data.
02

The mobile hero image is discovered late

The CSS hero image has no image preload, and the mobile trace records about 1.1 seconds of delay before its request.

  • Make patient-smiling.webp discoverable early on the homepage, without changing its quality; retest the actual hero LCP.
03

News cards select overly large thumbnails

A roughly 419-pixel news card selects an 843 KB image because its sizes rule describes a full-width image.

  • Correct the archive image sizes rule to match the actual card widths; keep existing srcset/lazy loading and preserve image quality.

Fix order

Separate schema identities, then improve image discovery and thumbnail selection without lowering quality.

  • Website: entity IDs, homepage hero discovery and archive sizes rule.
  • SEO: preserve verified hours/phone and existing completed work; review only evidence-backed refinements.

No broken internal HTML or duplicate content was confirmed. Correct business data stays. The full report preserves source evidence, existing work and Google-data limitations.
